sheet_layout.honest_titles: rendered inside every viewport: view name, mode and tick; diagnostic viewports carry the five declared diagnostic layers; footer carries the architecture line, layers and the run scalars
rows: frame 2k   diagnostic viewports [whole | side; front | close-up] with all five declared diagnostic layers
frame 2k+1 clean viewports (identical cameras, no labels, no overlays, depth-tested)
footer strip: architecture line and the layer list
